title: Attribution survives projection and exact withdrawal
statement: Within the declared domain of distinct nonempty claim ids, every historical claim retains its origin, id, epoch and span. Equal spans do not merge authors. Withdrawing a named id removes exactly that live line while history remains available.
boundary: Origin is attribution, not a key certificate. Distinct ids, keys or lineage labels do not identify independent causes; authority stays with the consumer instrument. No lineage recovery is inferred.
